Errors signalled by soilhub

Source: R/errors.R
soilhub-errors.Rd

Every error raised by the package is a condition of class soilhub_error (which inherits from error and condition) and of one of the classes below, so it can be caught selectively with tryCatch() or withCallingHandlers(). The fields listed are elements of the condition object (e$status, e$request_id, ...). They never hold a token or the content of an uploaded file.

ClassRaised whenFields
soilhub_argument_errora bad argument is caught before any request (bbox, enum value, NA, "ALL")argument
soilhub_dependency_errora suggested package (e.g. sf) is needed and not installedpackage
soilhub_auth_errorlogin denied or timed out, session expired and not renewable, HTTP 401, no default sessionreason (login_denied, login_timeout, session_expired, no_refresh_token, not_logged_in, no_session), partial
soilhub_permission_errorthe session lacks the right an operation needs, or HTTP 403required_right, rights, status, endpoint, request_id
soilhub_api_errorany other non-2xx response, an invalid JSON response, retries exhaustedstatus, endpoint, method, detail, request_id, code, attempts
soilhub_validation_errorHTTP 422: the API rejected the request contentas soilhub_api_error, plus errors (a data frame)
soilhub_load_limit_errorHTTP 422 load_limit_exceeded: the selection is above the limit of synchronous requests (or of exports)as soilhub_api_error, plus channel, max_observations, observation_count, observation_count_exact, exports_url, request, selection
soilhub_not_found_errorHTTP 404as soilhub_api_error
soilhub_conflict_errorHTTP 409 (idempotency replay with different content, duplicate product, illegal job transition)as soilhub_api_error
soilhub_unavailable_errorHTTP 503 after the retries, the API cannot be reached, or the request reached the total timeout (not repeated: narrow the selection or export)as soilhub_api_error, attempts, reason (timeout, transport_error)
soilhub_capability_errorthe server lacks a capability, or its API version is outside the supported rangecapability, api_version, minimum
soilhub_job_erroran export or job failed or was cancelled, polling timed out, or the job id is unknownjob, job_id, reason

soilhub_validation_error, soilhub_load_limit_error, soilhub_not_found_error, soilhub_conflict_error and soilhub_unavailable_error also inherit from soilhub_api_error.

A soilhub_load_limit_error carries the API's explanation followed by the way out: narrow the selection or request an export of the same selection with soil_export(). Its request field is the body sent and selection the selection arguments, ready to be passed on.

When a multi-page read fails after some pages were read, the error carries those pages in e$partial: their metadata has complete = FALSE and next_offset, the offset from which the read can continue.

request_id is the X-Request-ID of the failed request (generated by the client as soilhub-<yyyymmddHHMMSS>-<8 hex> and echoed by the API): quote it when reporting a problem.

See also

Other configuration and errors: soilhub-config

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
x <- tryCatch(
  soil_observations(soil, datasets = "wosis_points"),
  soilhub_load_limit_error = function(e) {
    message("Selection of ", e$observation_count, " observations: exporting")
    NULL
  },
  soilhub_error = function(e) {
    message("Request ", e$request_id, " failed: ", conditionMessage(e))
    NULL
  }
)
} # }
